subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned group messages for later mentioned turns, and under what bounded retention and visibility policy?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but preserving attachments from unmentioned group messages changes what later prompts can see and needs human intent on privacy, retention, allowed media kinds, and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Approve bounded image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it to later turns under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Keep text-only group history
options.body: Document that unmentioned Telegram media is not replayed from group history unless the current turn includes or replies to the attachment.

options.title: Require live design proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a live Telegram proof demonstrates the failure and proposed bounded retention behavior before implementation is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it to later turns under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest policy-path signal is prior work on mention-skipped group-message handling in the same Telegram skip branch.
